rules.name: Revit Warnings
rules.guidance: Review and resolve warnings, prioritizing repeated/geometry-related warnings.

rules.name: Imported CAD (not linked)
rules.guidance: Replace imported CAD with links where practical, then remove unnecessary imports.

rules.name: Linked CAD
rules.guidance: Confirm each CAD link is required and correctly positioned.

rules.name: In-Place Families
rules.guidance: Replace repeated or complex in-place content with loadable families.

rules.name: Model Groups
rules.guidance: Review model groups for unnecessary nesting or duplication.

rules.name: Detail Groups
rules.guidance: Review large quantities of detail groups for maintainability.

rules.name: Unpinned Revit Links
rules.guidance: Pin Revit links after confirming coordinates and placement.

rules.name: Unloaded Revit Links
rules.guidance: Confirm unloaded links are intentional before model exchange.

rules.name: Unplaced Rooms
rules.guidance: Place or delete rooms that are no longer needed.

rules.name: Unenclosed Rooms
rules.guidance: Resolve room-bounding conditions or delete obsolete rooms.

rules.name: Unplaced Spaces
rules.guidance: Place or delete MEP spaces that are no longer needed.

rules.name: Unenclosed Spaces
rules.guidance: Resolve space-bounding conditions or delete obsolete spaces.

rules.name: Unused View Templates
rules.guidance: Remove obsolete templates after confirming they are not required for future deliverables.

rules.name: Centerlines Visible
rules.guidance: Checks only the current active view. Centerlines count as visible only when the centerline category/subcategory and every parent category are visible. If the active view template controls the applicable V/G category setting, the template-controlled state is used.

rules.name: User Worksets
rules.guidance: Confirm the workset structure remains intentional and manageable.
